name: Ragga jungle vocal chops
desc: Dark, sparse, aggressive ragga jungle vocal stabs — chopped yeah/speech/ades2 samples pitch-dropped with speed alternation, off-canon echoes, jux(rev) in the peak. Mostly unpitched; sparse phrases in a half-time feel against fast drums.

code.full: s("yeah:3 ~ [yeah:7 yeah:2] ades2 ~ speech ~ yeah:5").speed("<1 .8 1.15 .9>").shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)).off(1/8, x=>x.speed(1.5).gain(.3)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.35).delay(.4).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.5).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: s("[yeah:3 yeah:5]*2 [speech ades2] [yeah:7 yeah:2 yeah:5 ades2] [yeah:3 speech]").speed("<1 .8 1.2 1.5 .9>").chop(2).shape(.5).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*2).slow(8)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.2,.8).slow(8)).off(1/8, x=>x.speed(2).gain(.3)).jux(rev).every(2, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.3).delay(.35).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.5).orbit(8).play()
